situation: You're starting a cooking reel and need people to stop scrolling.
say: Hi guys, welcome back to my channel. So today...
better: This 10-minute dal tastes like it cooked for hours. Here's the trick.
also: Stop adding water to your dal. Do this instead.
weak: Hello friends, please watch till the end, very important.
Today's video is very interesting, so let's start.
why: Lead with the payoff; greetings waste the first two seconds.

situation: You're writing a caption for a photo from your mountain trip.
say: Feeling blessed. #wanderlust #travel #mountains #nofilter
better: Woke up to this in Spiti. Minus five degrees and worth every shiver.
also: Three buses, one flat tyre, and this view. Worth it.
weak: The mountains are calling and I must go.
Nature is beautiful. Travel is life.
why: A specific detail beats lines everyone has already used.

situation: You loved a creator's money explainer and want to leave a comment.
say: Nice video bro, keep it up.
better: The SIP example finally made compounding click for me. Could you do one on tax next?
also: Saved this. The chart at 1:20 explained it better than my textbook.
weak: Superb, superb, superb.
Nice. Check out my page also.
why: Specific comments get noticed and start real conversations.

situation: A troll leaves a rude comment about your looks on a recipe reel.
say: Look at your own face first, then comment.
better: Thanks for watching. The recipe's in the caption if you want to try it.
also: Appreciate the view. Moving on.
weak: Who asked you? Go get a life, loser.
Why are you so jealous? Sad.
why: Don't feed trolls; a calm line or silence takes away their fun.

situation: A commenter points out a factual mistake in your video.
say: Bro, everyone makes mistakes. Chill.
better: You're right, I got that date wrong. Thanks for catching it. I've pinned a correction.
also: Good catch. Fixed it in the caption.
weak: If you know so much, make your own video.
It's a small mistake, the point is the same.
why: Owning a mistake in public builds trust with your audience.

situation: You want to DM a bigger creator about a collaboration.
say: Hi sir/ma'am, big fan. Can we do collab? Pls reply.
better: Hi Meera, I make budget travel videos (40k followers). I'd love to do a 'Goa on ₹5,000' collab with you. Interested?
also: Hi Meera, loved your Hampi reel. I have an idea for a joint video. Can I send a one-line pitch?
weak: Hello dear, kindly collab with me for mutual growth.
Hey, follow back and let's collab?
why: Say who you are, what you offer, and one clear idea.

situation: You want more likes and shares at the end of your reel.
say: Please like, share, subscribe and press the bell icon, guys, please!
better: If this helped, send it to the friend who always overspends.
also: Which tip will you try first? Tell me below.
weak: Like karo, share karo, support karo, please.
If you don't follow, you'll regret it.
why: Give people a reason or a question, not a plea.

situation: Your reel joked about a community, and people are rightly upset.
say: Sorry if anyone's feelings got hurt. It was just a joke.
better: My reel made fun of a community, and that was wrong. I've taken it down. I'm sorry, and I'll do better.
also: I got this wrong. No excuses. The video is down, and I'm listening.
weak: Sorry to those who can't take a joke.
My team posted it without checking, sorry guys.
why: A real apology names the harm, owns it and says what changes.

situation: Your small Instagram shop has delayed orders by a week.
say: Due to unavoidable circumstances, delays happened. Inconvenience is regretted.
better: Your orders are a week late because of a supplier problem. That's on us, and we're sorry. Everything ships by Friday.
also: Sorry for the wait. Here's exactly where your order is and when it will reach you.
weak: Delays are common in festive season, please be patient.
Kindly bear with us, we are trying our level best.
why: A specific reason, a real apology and a clear date.

situation: You're opening a reel about a common English mistake.
say: Today we will learn one important English grammar topic.
better: Stop saying 'revert back'. Here's what to say instead.
also: Most of us write this wrong in office emails. Do you?
weak: Very very important video for everyone, must watch.
Grammar class part 47, let's start.
why: Name the mistake upfront; curiosity keeps people watching.

situation: Someone leaves an abusive comment attacking your religion.
say: Your religion is worse. Go read your own books first.
better: I won't argue with abuse. Comments that attack anyone's faith will be removed here.
also: Respectful disagreement is welcome. Abuse isn't.
weak: Typical. People like you are the problem.
Reported, blocked, cry more.
why: Set a clear rule for your space instead of fighting back.

situation: Followers call you a 'sell-out' for a sponsored post.
say: Bro, I also have bills to pay. What's your problem?
better: Fair question. Yes, it's paid, and I only take brands I actually use. That's why it's tagged 'ad'.
also: It's sponsored, and I'll always say so. I won't push something I don't trust.
weak: Haters will hate, I don't care.
It's not sponsored, I just like the product.
why: Being open about paid content protects your credibility.

situation: You're announcing your new job on LinkedIn.
say: I am humbled and honoured to share that I have joined...
better: I've joined a Pune fintech startup as a product designer. Nervous, excited, and grateful to everyone who helped me get here.
also: New job: product designer at a Pune fintech. Big learning curve ahead, and I'm ready for it.
weak: With immense pleasure and gratitude to the almighty, I hereby announce my new role.
New job. Finally escaped my old toxic company.
why: Sound like a person, not a press release.

situation: Your dog is lost, and you want followers to share the post.
say: Please share maximum, guys!!! Very urgent!!!
better: Our dog Bruno went missing near Koramangala 5th Block on Sunday. Brown, red collar. Please share if you're in Bengaluru.
also: Lost near Koramangala: Bruno, brown, red collar. Any sighting helps, please DM me.
weak: Forward to all groups, it's our duty!!!
Please share, God will bless you.
why: Specific details make people act; exclamation marks don't.

situation: You disagree with a creator's health advice and want to comment.
say: Wrong information. Unfollow this fake doctor.
better: The guidelines I've read say this isn't safe for diabetics. Could you share your source?
also: Interesting take, but doesn't this clash with what most doctors advise?
weak: Mass report this page, guys.
Lol, another expert from Instagram university.
why: Disagree with evidence and a question, not a call to attack.

situation: A brand offers you a paid post for a product you don't trust.
say: Sir, sorry, currently very busy. Will see later.
better: Thanks for thinking of me. This one isn't a fit for my audience, so I'll pass. Happy to hear about future campaigns.
also: Appreciate the offer, but I'll sit this one out.
weak: Your product looks like a scam, no thanks.
Maybe later, let's see, will tell you.
why: A clear, polite no keeps the door open without false hope.

situation: A creator hasn't replied to your collab DM for a week.
say: Hello?? Seen and no reply?
better: Hi Arjun, just bumping this up in case it got buried. No worries if the timing isn't right.
also: Following up on my idea from last week. Happy to send a quick outline.
weak: Sir, please reply, I've messaged ten times.
I guess big creators don't reply to small ones.
why: A light, no-pressure nudge gets more replies than guilt.

situation: Someone comments 'cringe' on your dance reel.
say: Then why are you watching? Scroll ahead.
better: Cringe or not, I had fun making it. Thanks for stopping by.
also: Fair, it's not for everyone.
weak: You're cringe. Look at your own profile first.
Ok, I'll delete it then.
why: Owning it with humour takes the sting out.

situation: A viral post you shared yesterday turns out to be false.
say: Whatever, it was forwarded to me. I didn't make it.
better: Correction: the post I shared yesterday was false. I've deleted it. Here's the fact-check. I should have checked first.
also: I shared something untrue yesterday. Sorry, it's removed. Lesson learnt.
weak: Some say it's fake, some say it's real, who knows.
Deleted. Don't send me screenshots, please.
why: Correct it as loudly as you shared it.

situation: Your page has just crossed 10,000 followers.
say: Thank you for 10k fam!!! Love you all!!! Keep supporting!!!
better: 10k of you now. A year ago it was my mom and two friends. Thank you for every comment and share.
also: 10k. I read every comment, even when I can't reply. Thank you.
weak: 10k done, next target 100k, support karo!
Thanks to all my fans for this success.
why: A specific, personal thank-you feels real; '!!!' doesn't.

situation: You're opening a reel with your view on hustle culture.
say: Guys, today I am going to talk about a very important topic.
better: Working 14 hours a day is not ambition. It's bad planning. Let me explain.
also: Unpopular opinion: rest is part of the work.
weak: You will be shocked after watching this video.
Nobody is talking about this, so I will.
why: Start with the claim itself; avoid clickbait you can't deliver.

situation: You want followers to tell you what to post next.
say: Comment anything, guys, I need comments for the algorithm.
better: What should I cover next: budget meals or meal prep? Vote below.
also: What confused you in this video? I'll answer it in the next one.
weak: If you love me, comment 'yes'.
Drop suggestions, any suggestions, all welcome.
why: Easy, specific questions get real answers.

situation: Your café gets a one-star review online saying the coffee was cold.
say: Sir, our coffee is always hot. You must be mistaken.
better: Sorry your coffee arrived cold; that's not our standard. Show this review on your next visit, and the cup's on us.
also: Thanks for telling us. We've spoken to the team about serving times.
weak: We have 500 happy customers, one bad review doesn't matter.
Kindly remove this review, it is hurting our business.
why: Apologise, fix it and invite them back, in public.

situation: Another creator has copied your script almost word for word.
say: Shameless copycat! Everyone report this account!
better: Hi Kabir, your latest reel uses my script almost word for word. Please credit me or take it down.
also: I noticed my video reposted without credit. A tag would be great.
weak: Exposing this thief, full thread below.
No problem, copy whatever you want, I don't care.
why: Go to the person first, privately and clearly, before going public.

situation: An argument with a stranger in your comments has run to twenty replies.
say: Last reply from my side. You are just an idiot.
better: We clearly see this differently. I've said my piece, so I'll leave it here. Take care.
also: We won't convince each other in the comments. All the best.
weak: Blocked. Go cry somewhere else.
Ok, you win. Happy?
why: Leave the thread calmly; you don't need the last word.
